title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Protection Plan Terms
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental damage protection is taken at checkout and charged on the rental time of the agreement. The percentages, limits and exclusion flags named here are the class figures of the damage protection schedule.

## 1. The protection charge

When damage protection was taken, the damage protection charge is the class's damage protection percentage of the rental time charges, rounded to the nearest cent, billed as one line on the billing date. The rental time charges are the rental time billed on the agreement less the ProBuild rental discount and the malfunction credits posted on it, in a class whose protection charge is figured on rental time after the discount; in a class where it is not, they are the rental time billed before those reductions.

*Hypothetical:* rental time billed 300.00, ProBuild discount 30.00, no malfunction credit, protection at 15 percent figured after the discount: 15 percent of 270.00, that is 40.50.

## 2. Accidental damage under the plan

> Former clause: with damage protection, accidental damage found at inspection was covered up to the class coverage limit per incident, the renter paying the class deductible plus any repair cost above the coverage limit. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the damage deductible and for adjusting protected damage repair charges.

## 3. What the plan never covers

Damage protection never covers loss or theft in a class where loss and theft are excluded, tire and track damage in a class where tire and track damage is excluded, or damage caused by misuse; those repair costs are billed in full as a damage repair charge.

## 4. Without damage protection

Without damage protection, the full repair cost assessed at the return inspection is billed as a damage repair charge.

## 5. Other return charges

Damage protection never covers cleaning, refuelling or missing accessories.

## Coverage table for damage found at inspection

| Cause recorded at inspection | Class excludes it | Damage protection taken | Repair cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| misuse | always excluded | either | billed in full as damage repair |
| theft or loss | yes | either | billed in full as damage repair |
| tire or track damage | yes | either | billed in full as damage repair |
| any cause | not applicable | no | billed in full as damage repair |

superseded_clauses: With damage protection, accidental damage found at inspection is covered up to damage_protection_covers_up_to_usd per incident: the renter pays damage_protection_deductible_usd (fee_type damage_deductible) plus any repair cost above the coverage limit (fee_type damage_repair).
